anomalies.description: A person wearing a blue cap and dark jacket enters the frame from the right at ~45.4s, moves toward the camera, and then abruptly turns and leans down sharply (~49.5s–51.0s), partially obscuring the view. No clear theft is visible, but the posture and timing are highly atypical for normal customer behavior.

No clear theft is visible, but the posture and timing are highly atypical for normal customer behavior.

A man in a blue cap and jacket enters the frame, looks around furtively, then bends down sharply (frames 3–4), partially obscuring his hands near the lower shelf—consistent with concealing or taking an item (shoplifting). He then quickly exits the frame left (frame 6), exhibiting behavior typical of suspicious retail theft.
